name: Wet Fish 33
author: SantiagoBoS
description: Rounded gray card that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, width becomes 190px, height becomes 254px, background changes from #000000 to #ffffff. On focus, starts the cardAnimacion animation (moving), box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 0.8em #ffffff, border-radius becomes 20px.
